> **Beta of this fork** of [iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy](https://github.com/iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy), built on upstream **2.0.6**. Samsung packages: Tizen 6.5–7 (`NuvioTpk65`) and Tizen 8–9 (`NuvioTpk`). It is a pre-release, so installed apps do not auto-update to it: install the `.tpk` by hand (Apps2Samsung).

## Player: seeking
- **Taps** on Left/Right add 10 s each and show the total in the middle of the screen ("+30 s"). The video keeps playing and jumps when you stop pressing.
- **Holding** pauses and speeds up in visible steps: 20× → 40× → 80× → 160× → 320× → 640×.
- **OK** confirms the jump; **Back** cancels it and returns to where you were.

## Cards and title page
- The **watched** badge is an eye on a fixed light disc (it no longer changes colour with each poster).
- The add-to-list button shows a **library** icon once the title is saved.
- **IMDb ratings** from MDBList show correctly (7.9, not 79.0).

## Home and Saved
- "Continue Watching" no longer shows the movie icon.
- Captions under the logo read "2026 · Drama · Thriller", without repeating Movie/TV Show.
- Timeline rows: the focused year no longer overlaps the poster badges.
- Top 10: the "10" is readable.
- Saved › Continue no longer lists titles you have finished.
